result.title: One Pretrained Decision Model Is Enough for Training-Free Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular entities in graph-structured data, yet heterogeneous anomaly patterns and distributional differences across graphs challenge generalizable detection. Existing training-free approaches avoid task-specific optimization but primarily rely on predefined numerical scoring rules, leaving the semantic interpretation of heterogeneous anomaly evidence largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Jev-GAD, a training-free generalist graph anomaly detection framework that bridges heterogeneous numerical evidence and pretrained decision mechanisms. To address heterogeneous anomaly patterns, we construct complementary structural, attribute, and neighborhood evidence and transform heterogeneous statistics into graph-relative anomaly percentiles. To move beyond predefined numerical scoring rules, we leverage a single frozen pretrained language model for evidence-conditioned anomaly assessment. To bridge the semantic gap between numerical evidence and pretrained models, we design a semantic Graph-to-State (G2S) transformation that organizes graph context and semantically labeled node evidence into structured decision states for non-generative option-logit readout. The resulting decision scores are integrated with four complementary statistical scores through equal-weight rank-based fusion, without GAD-specific gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments on seven graph anomaly detection benchmarks spanning citation, social, and co-review networks demonstrate the effectiveness of Jev-GAD, achieving average AUROC and AUPRC scores of 89.18\% and 52.40\%, respectively. Further analyses validate the contributions of pretrained decision readout and semantic evidence grounding.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Jev-GAD，一个无需训练的通用的图异常检测框架：将结构、属性与邻域统计转为图内相对分位数，经语义 Graph-to-State 变换组织成结构化决策状态，由冻结的预训练语言模型以选项 logit 方式读出异常判断，再与统计分数秩融合。
AI.relevance_reason: 应用领域是图异常检测，但「异构证据→结构化状态→冻结模型非生成式读出」的流程可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何序列化为可读出的内部状态、以及免训练的证据筛选与判定提供可供核查的线索。
